create_get_norm: create a normalization layer from config using get_norm with batchnorm, sub_batchnorm, or sync_batchnorm types
build_sub_batchnorm3d: build a SubBatchNorm3d module that splits batch dimension into N splits for independent BN stats computation
test_aggregate_stats: test the aggregate_stats method to synchronize running_mean and running_var before evaluation mode
review_forward_method: review the forward method of SubBatchNorm3d that applies split BN in training and aggregated BN in eval
summarize_get_norm: summarize how get_norm returns nn.BatchNorm3d, SubBatchNorm3d, or NaiveSyncBatchNorm3d based on cfg.BN.NORM_TYPE
